candidates.priorities_note: We found no campaign website for him. South Carolina's official candidate page lists none, and a web search on Oct 8, 2026 found none.
Her website's “On the Issues” page is a list of blog posts by date, not a list of issues, so there's no top 3. Her stances below come from those posts and her home page.

cost-of-living.heading: Meet Dr. Kasie Whitener
cost-of-living.quote: Kasie will bring real oversight, end protectionist policies and laws, and get government out of the way so people can prosper.

health-care.heading: Healthcare: Decoupled
health-care.quote: So: decouple. Decouple health insurance from health care. Decouple health insurance from employment.

immigration.heading: Bad laws make for bad enforcement
immigration.quote: I said I think people who come to the United States should do so legally. We should have a resident-worker program that enables them to become registered workers.

foreign-policy.heading: Do the ends justify the means?
foreign-policy.quote: As the United States was not attacked by Venezuela or Iran, I oppose the use of force in both circumstances. Presidents cannot be allowed to go to war at will or on whims.
